summary: The PR addresses the issue of passing -X options to the auto-reloader, but there are some concerns about potential behavioral regressions and style.

issues.description: Adding '-X%s' % o for o in sys._xoptions` could introduce behavioral regressions if not all values in `sys._xoptions` are safe to pass to the subprocess. This needs further investigation.
The use of string formatting (`'-X%s' % o`) is slightly outdated. Using f-strings (`f'-X{o}'`) would align better with modern Python conventions.
